title: Integration Tests and Test Doubles
introduction: Unit tests isolate focused behaviour; integration tests verify that real components agree at their boundaries.
learningOutcomes: Use a test double at a slow or unreliable boundary.

activities.question: Which test best checks that application code and a real database schema agree?
options: A unit test with no database
activities.explanation: An integration test crosses the real boundary and can reveal contract mismatches.

activities.question: Every unit test should call a live public network service.
activities.explanation: Live services make focused tests slow and unreliable; controlled substitutes usually fit unit tests better.

activities.question: A controlled replacement used during a test is a test ___.
activities.explanation: Stubs, fakes and mocks are kinds of test doubles with different purposes.
